credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Image from the August 1961 raft trip down the Colorado River; portrait of O'Keeffe with back to camera standing on a small section of the riverbed with looking down.  She is wearing a white head scarf, long sleeve cotton jacket and shirt. A shaft of light cascades down the side of the canyon wall.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe at Glen Canyon
